initiatives.one_liner: Modernize the Tunduk inter-agency data exchange platform (KG's X-Road equivalent) under live RFP KG-T-2026-005 ($1.8M) and the post-Минцифры transfer to UDP, replicating Estonia X-Road maturity gains.
initiatives.problem_statement: Tunduk is the State Enterprise operating Kyrgyzstan's inter-agency data exchange platform (X-Road derivative). Following the Mintsifry liquidation, Tunduk SE was transferred to UDP control via KG-TUNDUK-INFOCOM-TRANSFER. Live RFP KG-T-2026-005 ($1.8M, Tunduk platform modernization — API gateway and data management) is open. KG-LAW-2025-178-DIGITAL-CODE and its enactment law (KG-LAW-2025-179-DIGITAL-CODE-ENACTMENT) require Tunduk to host the AI auditability and model registry mandated by the Digital Code. Existing platform is functional but lacks modern API gateway, observability, and the AI inference fabric needed for the next decade. Estonia X-Road / X-Tee (case-est-xroad) is the reference architecture; case-kg-tunduk-modernisation documents the ongoing modernization track.
initiatives.solution_concept: Three-component delivery: (1) modern API gateway with OAuth2/OIDC, rate-limiting, circuit-breaker patterns and observability stack — replacing the current bespoke routing layer; (2) data-management plane with consent receipt management compliant with KG-LAW-2008-058 (personal information law) and Digital Code amendments; (3) AI inference fabric — a managed-runtime layer on which any government agency can deploy a model and have its consumption metered, logged for the Digital Code AI registry, and routed through Tunduk's identity layer. Architecturally anchored on Estonia X-Road maturity (case-est-xroad) preserved as core; adapted for KG's centralized UDP governance, Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual operator UX, and the Digital Code AI auditability requirements that are unique to KG.
initiatives.what_preserved: X-Road peer-to-peer data exchange, message-level signing, audit trail, security server architecture — all production-proven across Estonia, Finland, Iceland.
initiatives.what_adapted: Centralized UDP governance (KG model is more centralized than Estonia's distributed pattern), Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual operator console, AI registry and inference fabric layer (Digital Code requirement absent in Estonia), integration with the Tunduk SE operational team.
initiatives.regulatory_hurdles: Digital Code AI auditability provisions are still being detailed by KG-AI-SECONDARY-REG-WORKING-GROUP. Vendor must follow the secondary regulation drafting closely to avoid building against an outdated specification. Mitigation: bid as part of the same vendor stack participating in Digital Code secondary regulation drafting (linked initiative KG-INI-008).
initiatives.primary_funding: EU C4CA (Connectivity for Central Asia) + KOICA Tunduk Modernization + state budget under UDP
initiatives.competitive_landscape: Cybernetica AS (Estonia) is the historical X-Road technology incumbent and has KG context via EU C4CA. NIIPI Vector (regional Russian SI) sanctions-exposed. Local Kyrgyz integrators (HTP residents) lack API-gateway and observability depth. Open positioning if vendor can field Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual + modern cloud-native API stack + AI inference fabric simultaneously — a triple Cybernetica cannot match.
initiatives.mandatory_local_partner: Tunduk SE technical team + HTP IT integrator. Tunduk SE itself (kg-tunduk-tech-lead, Mirlan Asanbekov) is the operational counterpart and partner-of-record.
initiatives.win_conditions: (1) Co-author Tunduk 2.0 TOR via the UDP TOR initiative (KG-INI-001); (2) Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual operator console demo by submission deadline; (3) Estonia eGA endorsement letter (kg-tonis-mae); (4) Tunduk SE technical lead pre-buy on AI inference fabric architecture; (5) KOICA TTL alignment letter.
initiatives.pilot_scope: Pilot covering API gateway modernization + Digital Code AI registry MVP for 5 government agencies (UDP, Cabinet, NBKR, MoH, MoF) with Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual operator console.
pilot_success_metrics: API gateway processing ≥1000 RPS sustained across 5 agencies
AI registry contains ≥20 government AI models with audit trail
Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual operator console deployed with named UDP operator users
P99 latency < 500ms for inter-agency data exchange
Compliance audit pass under Digital Code secondary regulation provisions
initiatives.scale_up_path: Year 1: Phase 1 modernization across 5 agencies. Year 2: full Tunduk modernization across 30+ agencies, AI inference fabric onboarding government LLMs and computer-vision services. Year 3: license inference fabric pattern to UZ government cloud (UzCloud) as regional reference architecture, position for ITU regional digital integration role.
initiatives.pitch_hook: KG-LAW-2025-178 mandates an AI registry on Tunduk and KG-T-2026-005 ($1.8M) is open now to modernize the platform. Estonia X-Road proves the architecture; Kazakhstan and Azerbaijan have copied it. We bring the only Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual API-gateway + AI inference fabric stack that satisfies Digital Code auditability on day one — Cybernetica's classic X-Road build does not.

risk_register.description: Cybernetica's incumbency and EU twinning relationship gives them the inside track and they will defend it.
risk_register.mitigation: Position as complement not competitor: Cybernetica owns the X-Road core, we own the AI inference fabric and Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual operator console. Propose subcontract or partnership structure where each vendor delivers their differentiated layer. Reference Estonia eGA endorsement (kg-tonis-mae) to avoid antagonizing the Estonia ecosystem.

risk_register.description: Digital Code secondary regulations are still being drafted (kg-trend-003-digital-code-secondary-regs). Building an AI registry against a draft specification risks rework when final regulation lands.
risk_register.mitigation: Win the linked Digital Code secondary regulation TA contract (KG-INI-008) so we are inside the spec authorship loop. Architect the AI registry with versioned schema and explicit migration path between draft and final specification.

risk_register.description: Tunduk SE was just transferred from Mintsifry to UDP. Operational governance of Tunduk SE may be revisited (KG-TUNDUK-INFOCOM-TRANSFER suggests partial transfer to GP Infocom).
risk_register.mitigation: Build dual relationships at Tunduk SE (kg-tunduk-gp-head, Marat Isakov) and at GP Infocom and at UDP. Anchor at the technical lead level (kg-tunduk-tech-lead, Mirlan Asanbekov) where engineering continuity is highest.

next_30_day_actions: Submit pre-qualification documentation for KG-T-2026-005 ($1.8M Tunduk modernization) before submission deadline.
LinkedIn message to kg-tunduk-gp-head (Marat Isakov, Tunduk SE Director) referencing case-est-xroad maturity model and offering Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual operator demo.
Reach out to KOICA-KG-TUNDUK TTL via KOICA Bishkek office citing the active KOICA-KG-TUNDUK $5M co-financing pipeline.
Brief Estonia eGA's KG advisor (kg-tonis-mae) on partnership rather than competitive positioning vs. Cybernetica.
Reach out to EU C4CA PIU (kg-eu-piu-c4ca) for technical assistance alignment letter.

scoring.scoring_rationale: Speed 10: live RFP KG-T-2026-005 closing in current cycle. Moat 9: post-Минцифры governance flux means even the incumbent (Cybernetica) needs to re-establish position. Defensibility 9: Tunduk hosts identity and inter-agency data — multi-year switching cost. Capital 9: KOICA $5M + EU C4CA + UDP state budget. Russian/CIS Fit 9: Russian-Kyrgyz operator UX needed, sntz.ai stack fits, sanctions-clean positioning preferred.

initiatives.short_name: KG eHealth EHR & AI Diagnostic Platform
initiatives.one_liner: Deliver electronic health record and AI diagnostic suite for the Ministry of Health under live RFP KG-T-2026-006 ($4.03M), replicating Estonia e-Health and Kazakhstan Damumed precedents.
initiatives.problem_statement: KG-MINHEALTH lacks national EHR; existing data is fragmented across hospital systems. Live tender KG-T-2026-006 ($4.03M, digital health: EHR + AI diagnostic support) is open. Constitutional commitment to digital governance (KG-UP-2024-090-CONCEPT) and Digital Code (KG-LAW-2025-178) mandate health-data interoperability via Tunduk. AKDN-KG-DIGITAL-SCHOOLS2030 ($15M, AKDN) and UNICEF-KG-DIGITAL-EARLY ($1.5M) provide co-financing pathway for child and rural health. Estonia E-Health (case-est-ehealth), Kazakhstan Damumed (case-kz-damumed), and Bangladesh a2i Telemedicine (case-bd-a2i-health) are precedent cases. KG mountain geography (>90% mountainous, scattered population) makes telemedicine + AI triage especially high-value.
initiatives.solution_concept: Three-layer platform: (1) National EHR core with Tunduk-bound identity (KGz citizen ID), patient data store, and clinician-facing UX in Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual; (2) AI diagnostic suite — radiology image triage (chest X-ray TB screening priority, given KG TB burden), retinal screening for diabetic retinopathy, ECG arrhythmia detection — running as inference services on Tunduk inference fabric (linked to KG-INI-003); (3) Telemedicine triage for mountain communities (linked to KG-INI-006), AKDN co-financed, with offline-capable mobile app for ayil ambulatories. Architectural anchor: Estonia e-terviseportaal (case-est-ehealth) + Damumed clinical decision support (case-kz-damumed) + a2i community-clinic delivery model (case-bd-a2i-health). Adapted for KG's centralized procurement, Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual UX, Tunduk integration, and mountain telemedicine field constraints.
initiatives.what_preserved: Estonia e-Health architecture: patient record data store, X-Road-bound consent, clinician-facing portal — proven in production for 1.3M citizens since 2008.
initiatives.what_adapted: Tunduk integration (rather than X-Road), Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual UX, AI diagnostic suite (Estonia e-Health is foundational EHR not AI-heavy), telemedicine offline mountain delivery (AKDN-funded use case absent in Estonia), Damumed-style clinical decision support imported on top.
initiatives.regulatory_hurdles: Personal information law KG-LAW-2008-058 + Digital Code data localization for sensitive personal data (health). Mitigation: deploy on Tunduk-aligned data residency, no cross-border PHI flow without explicit consent receipt.
initiatives.primary_funding: Ministry of Health state budget + AKDN-KG-DIGITAL-SCHOOLS2030 co-financing + UNICEF-KG-DIGITAL-EARLY
initiatives.competitive_landscape: Damumed (Kazakhstan, regional incumbent for health) is direct competitor with sectoral influence and Russian-language native. InterSystems and Allscripts (international EHR vendors) have presence via WB but expensive and not Russian-Kyrgyz native. Estonia e-Health team via eGA twinning (kg-tonis-mae) advisory. Local KG integrators lack AI diagnostic depth. Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual + AI diagnostic + AKDN telemedicine integration is the differentiator package.
initiatives.mandatory_local_partner: HTP IT integrator + named hospital network partner (Bishkek Republican Hospital + Osh Inter-Oblast Hospital) for clinical co-design.
initiatives.win_conditions: (1) Live tender KG-T-2026-006 pre-qualification by deadline; (2) AKDN endorsement letter via AKDN-KG-DIGITAL-SCHOOLS2030 PIU; (3) UNICEF TTL alignment for child/early-learning health overlap; (4) Damumed-comparable clinical decision support demo; (5) Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual EHR demo with Bishkek Republican Hospital pilot patients.
initiatives.pilot_scope: Pilot at Bishkek Republican Hospital + 3 Naryn rural ambulatories (mountain telemedicine link) + Osh Inter-Oblast Hospital, covering 50K patients in Year 1.
pilot_success_metrics: ≥85% sensitivity on chest X-ray TB triage AI vs. radiologist baseline
≥40% reduction in mountain-to-Bishkek referral time via telemedicine triage
Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual clinician UX with named clinician users at Bishkek Republican Hospital
Compliance audit pass under KG-LAW-2008-058 personal information law
initiatives.scale_up_path: Year 1: pilot 50K patients, 4 sites. Year 2: scale to all oblast hospitals (~30 sites) + 200 ayil ambulatories with AKDN telemedicine. Year 3: AI diagnostic suite expanded (cardiology, dermatology), regional license to UZ MoH and Tajikistan MoH.
initiatives.pitch_hook: Estonia e-Health serves 1.3M citizens with X-Road; Kazakhstan Damumed proves the regional Russian-language clinical UX. KG-T-2026-006 ($4.03M) is open now to deliver KG's first integrated EHR + AI diagnostic + mountain telemedicine stack. AKDN co-finances the mountain rollout. We bring Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual sntz.ai radiology AI ready to deploy on Tunduk inference fabric.

risk_register.description: Damumed bids with Kazakhstan precedent and Russian-language UX directly comparable. They are the natural regional incumbent.
risk_register.mitigation: Differentiate on Kyrgyz-language clinical UX (Damumed is Russian-only at scale), AI diagnostic depth, AKDN mountain telemedicine integration, and Tunduk inference fabric native deployment (not just bolted-on).

risk_register.description: MoH leadership (Alymkadyr Beishenaliev) tenure not guaranteed; ministerial rotation in KG averages 18 months.
risk_register.mitigation: Build dual relationship at MoH minister level and at clinical lead level (Bishkek Republican Hospital director — pre-identify and brief). Anchor parallel relationship at AKDN PIU which is donor-side.

risk_register.description: Mountain telemedicine connectivity is unreliable; offline-first design is required and rarely delivered well by EHR vendors.
risk_register.mitigation: Engineer offline-first sync layer with explicit conflict resolution; partner with KG-MEGACOM (state mobile operator, KG-MEGACOM institution) for connectivity SLAs in pilot zones.

next_30_day_actions: Submit pre-qualification documentation for KG-T-2026-006 ($4.03M) before submission deadline.
LinkedIn message to kg-minzdrav-head (Alymkadyr Beishenaliev) referencing AKDN partnership and Estonia e-Health architecture.
Schedule meeting with AKDN-KG-DIGITAL-SCHOOLS2030 PIU (kg-akdn-piu) for endorsement letter.
Brief Estonia eGA's KG advisor (kg-tonis-mae) on EHR architecture and request Estonia e-Health reference letter.
Reach out to UNICEF-KG-DIGITAL-EARLY TTL for child/early-learning health overlap alignment letter.

scoring.scoring_rationale: Speed 9: live RFP, decision within 90 days. Moat 8: Damumed competition limits moat. Defensibility 9: EHR multi-year SLAs, clinical workflow lock-in. Capital 9: AKDN $15M + UNICEF $1.5M + state budget. Russian/CIS Fit 9: Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual mandatory, sntz.ai radiology AI fits.

initiatives.one_liner: Deliver AI-powered fraud detection, supplier scoring and analytics for KG's State Procurement Agency under the ADB Phase 2 successor to Project 55109-001 (Aibek Abdybakirov TTL).
initiatives.problem_statement: ADB-KG-55109-001 ($650K Phase 1) has completed initial e-Procurement digitalization. Phase 2 will procure AI analytics, fraud detection, and supplier scoring on top of the digitalized procurement platform. Live RFP KG-T-2026-002 ($150K, IT audit) is the precursor. Forthcoming Phase 2 award expected mid-2026. KG-LAW-2022-027 (new procurement law) and KG-LAW-2025-243 / KG-LAW-2025-262 (legislative amendments) create the regulatory frame for AI-assisted procurement decision support. Kazakhstan Smart Bridge tax integration (case-kz-smartbridge-tax) and India e-procurement reference patterns inform the architecture.
initiatives.solution_concept: Three-component AI overlay on the digitalized e-procurement platform: (1) supplier risk scoring — ML model rating each registered supplier on prior contract performance, beneficial-ownership red flags, and price-anomaly history; (2) bid anomaly detection — clustering algorithms flagging suspicious price patterns, shell-company linkages, and bid-rotation rings; (3) procurement decision support dashboard for the State Procurement Agency leadership in Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual. Architectural anchor: Kazakhstan SmartBridge tax-procurement integration and Korea KONEPS analytics overlay. Adapted for KG's central procurement model (KG-PROCUREMENT-DEPT under Cabinet) and integration with Tunduk for beneficial-ownership cross-reference.
initiatives.what_preserved: Kazakhstan SmartBridge analytics overlay on procurement: risk scoring, anomaly detection, decision support dashboard.
initiatives.what_adapted: KG centralized procurement model, Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual UX, Tunduk-bound beneficial-ownership cross-reference, integration with KG-LAW-2022-027 procurement law thresholds.
initiatives.regulatory_hurdles: Procurement law confidentiality provisions limit which bid data can be analyzed cross-tender. Mitigation: design with explicit data partitioning by tender lifecycle stage; analytics on closed tenders only for retrospective scoring.
initiatives.primary_funding: ADB Project 55109-001 Phase 2 + state budget under Cabinet of Ministers procurement department
initiatives.competitive_landscape: Empty field. Existing Phase 1 vendor relationship is on the digitalization track, not analytics. Korea KONEPS-style vendors not present in KG. SmartBridge / Kazakhstan vendors not yet bidding. Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual + agentic analytics layer is the moat.
initiatives.mandatory_local_partner: HTP IT integrator + State Procurement Agency technical team.
initiatives.win_conditions: (1) ADB TTL Aibek Abdybakirov (kg-aibek-abdybakirov) endorsement letter; (2) State Procurement Agency director Kadyrbayev (kg-goszakupki-head) pre-buy on architecture; (3) Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual analytics dashboard demo; (4) Tunduk integration roadmap for beneficial-ownership cross-reference; (5) Cabinet procurement law compliance opinion from KG legal partner.
initiatives.pilot_scope: Pilot covering AI analytics on procurement data from Q4 2025 forward, focused on top-100 high-value tenders, with risk scoring of all registered suppliers.
pilot_success_metrics: ≥80% precision on flagged bid anomalies validated by procurement agency review
Risk scores for all ≥5,000 registered suppliers in production database
Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual dashboard deployed with named procurement agency users
≥3 successful fraud detection cases referred to anti-corruption agency
initiatives.scale_up_path: Year 1: ADB Phase 2 award. Year 2: extend to oblast-level procurement, integrate with State Tax Service (KG-GNS) cross-data check. Year 3: regional license to UZ State Procurement and Tajikistan; position as ADB regional reference architecture.
initiatives.pitch_hook: ADB Project 55109 Phase 1 digitalized KG procurement — Phase 2 needs the AI analytics overlay that turns digital records into fraud detection. Kazakhstan SmartBridge proves the architecture works in Russian-language CIS context. We deliver Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual supplier risk scoring + bid anomaly detection on Tunduk integration in 9 months, ADB-compliant.

risk_register.description: Phase 1 vendor extends scope into analytics rather than tendering Phase 2 separately.
risk_register.mitigation: Engage ADB TTL early to confirm tendering of Phase 2 as separate procurement; lobby for ICB modality which favors specialized AI analytics vendors over digitalization generalists.

risk_register.description: Procurement reform is politically sensitive — anti-corruption flag-raising can generate blowback against the procurement agency leadership.
risk_register.mitigation: Frame system as decision-support not auto-decision; preserve human-in-the-loop for all enforcement actions. Anchor relationship at the procurement department director level so political cover is institutional.

risk_register.description: KG procurement data quality is uneven; supplier registration records have gaps.
risk_register.mitigation: Phase 1 of pilot scoped to Q4 2025-forward records where digitalization is complete. Build data-quality scoring as part of supplier risk score so gaps are visible not silent.

next_30_day_actions: Submit pre-qualification documentation for KG-T-2026-002 ($150K IT audit) as relationship-builder.
LinkedIn message to kg-aibek-abdybakirov (ADB TTL) on Phase 2 architecture.
Schedule meeting with kg-goszakupki-head (Azamat Kadyrbayev) via ADB warm intro.
Brief ADB-KG-54383-001 capacity-building track for cross-program leverage.
Build Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual analytics dashboard MVR using public KG procurement data.

scoring.scoring_rationale: Speed 9: ADB Phase 2 imminent. Moat 9: empty-field with sntz.ai differentiation. Defensibility 8: ADB multi-phase relationships are renewable. Capital 9: ADB $650K Phase 1 + Phase 2 + state budget. Russian/CIS Fit 9: Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual mandatory, sntz.ai stack direct.

initiatives.one_liner: Deploy AI telemedicine triage for KG mountain communities under AKDN-KG-DIGITAL-SCHOOLS2030 and forthcoming KG-TF-2026-010 ($1.8M), replicating Bangladesh a2i and Rwanda Babyl precedents.
initiatives.problem_statement: Kyrgyzstan is >90% mountainous with scattered rural population and acute shortage of specialists outside Bishkek and Osh. AKDN-KG-DIGITAL-SCHOOLS2030 ($15M) and EU-KG-SDC-GOVERNANCE ($16.2M) co-finance digital health and rural inclusion. Forthcoming tender KG-TF-2026-010 ($1.8M, mountain telemedicine IoT + AI diagnostic) is in pipeline. Bangladesh a2i Telemedicine + community clinics (case-bd-a2i-health), Rwanda Babyl AI chatbot (case-rw-babyl), India eSanjeevani (case-in-esanjeevani), and Estonia e-Health (case-est-ehealth) are precedent cases. Mountain telemedicine is one of the highest-impact AI-for-good use cases globally.
initiatives.solution_concept: Three-tier delivery: (1) ayil ambulatory clinic kit — point-of-care diagnostic device pack (smartphone-grade ECG, otoscope, dermascope) running offline-first AI triage models in Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual; (2) telemedicine bridge with Bishkek Republican Hospital and Osh Inter-Oblast Hospital for specialist consult; (3) AI symptom triage chatbot routing patients between self-care, ambulatory visit, telemedicine bridge, and emergency referral — Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual, deployed via Telegram/WhatsApp for accessibility. Architectural anchor: Bangladesh a2i community-clinic model + Rwanda Babyl chatbot triage + India eSanjeevani national platform integration. Adapted for KG mountain offline constraints, Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual UX, Tunduk-bound patient identity, AKDN's existing presence in Naryn/Osh oblasts.
initiatives.what_preserved: Bangladesh a2i community-clinic AI triage model: device kit, telemedicine bridge, chatbot routing — proven across thousands of rural clinics.
initiatives.what_adapted: Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual UX (Bangladesh is Bangla-only), KG mountain offline-first connectivity, AKDN co-funding and on-the-ground presence in Naryn/Osh, integration with national EHR (linked KG-INI-004), Tunduk identity binding.
initiatives.regulatory_hurdles: Personal information law data residency for PHI; medical device regulation for diagnostic kit. Mitigation: deploy on Tunduk-aligned residency; partner with Kyrgyzpatent for medical device certification pathway.
initiatives.competitive_landscape: AKDN has been the dominant Naryn/Osh on-ground partner for 25 years and has its own Aga Khan Health Service network — they are partner not competitor. International telemedicine vendors (Babyl/Telerivet) lack Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual capability. Local KG telemedicine pilots are pre-AI. Open positioning for Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual + AI triage + AKDN partnership.
initiatives.mandatory_local_partner: Aga Khan Health Service (AKHS) Kyrgyzstan + Bishkek Republican Hospital + Osh Inter-Oblast Hospital — clinical partner-of-record at three tiers.
initiatives.win_conditions: (1) AKDN-KG-DIGITAL-SCHOOLS2030 PIU partnership letter; (2) AKHS Kyrgyzstan clinical co-design agreement; (3) Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual AI triage chatbot demo; (4) MoH (kg-minzdrav-head) pre-buy on architecture; (5) UNICEF-KG-DIGITAL-EARLY child-health overlap alignment.
initiatives.pilot_scope: Pilot at 10 Naryn ayil ambulatories + 5 Osh oblast ambulatories, covering 30K patients in Year 1, with Bishkek Republican Hospital telemedicine bridge.
pilot_success_metrics: ≥30K patient triage interactions handled in 12 months
≥80% sensitivity on AI symptom triage vs. clinician baseline
Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual chatbot deployed with named clinician users in 15 sites
Integration with national EHR (linked KG-INI-004) operational
initiatives.scale_up_path: Year 1: 15-site pilot in Naryn + Osh. Year 2: 200-site rollout to all rural ayil ambulatories with AKDN co-finance. Year 3: regional license to Tajikistan AKDN footprint and UZ Surkhandarya/Kashkadarya mountain regions.
initiatives.pitch_hook: Bangladesh a2i delivers AI triage to thousands of community clinics; Rwanda Babyl handles symptom triage at national scale. Kyrgyzstan is >90% mountainous, AKDN funds rural digital health, and KG-TF-2026-010 ($1.8M) is in pipeline. We deliver Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual offline-first AI triage on AKHS clinical infrastructure — the only stack that works above 2,500 meters with intermittent connectivity.

risk_register.description: Mountain connectivity is unreliable; offline-first AI triage requires careful edge model deployment.
risk_register.mitigation: Engineer offline-first sync with edge model deployment; partner with KG-MEGACOM for connectivity SLAs; design fallback paper-trail for network outages.

risk_register.description: AKDN may prefer to lead the technical delivery itself via AKDN's internal digital team rather than contract external vendor.
risk_register.mitigation: Position as AKDN technical-implementation partner not competitor; structure as subcontract under AKDN PIU with named co-author credit.

risk_register.description: MoH leadership rotation; budget reallocation away from mountain health if Bishkek/Osh urban priorities dominate.
risk_register.mitigation: Anchor at AKDN PIU (donor-side) which has its own multi-year strategic plan independent of MoH leadership; maintain dual relationship at AKHS clinical level.

next_30_day_actions: Schedule meeting with AKDN-KG-DIGITAL-SCHOOLS2030 PIU (kg-akdn-piu) for partnership letter.
LinkedIn message to kg-minzdrav-head (Alymkadyr Beishenaliev) on AKDN partnership and offline-first telemedicine.
Reach out to AKHS Kyrgyzstan clinical leadership for co-design agreement.
Build Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual symptom-triage chatbot MVR for Telegram channel demo.
Track KG-TF-2026-010 publication via procurement portal.

scoring.scoring_rationale: Speed 8: forthcoming RFP within 12 months, AKDN funding active. Moat 9: AKDN is partner-of-record, no real competitor in Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual mountain telemedicine. Defensibility 9: clinical workflow lock-in, AKDN multi-year. Capital 10: AKDN $15M + EU SDC $16.2M + UNICEF $1.5M. Russian/CIS Fit 9: Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual mandatory.

initiatives.one_liner: Deliver AI-powered glacier monitoring and Glacial Lake Outburst Flood early-warning system for Ministry of Energy / Emergency Service under forthcoming KG-TF-2026-008 ($2.8M), replicating Netherlands Deltares Flood AI.
initiatives.problem_statement: Kyrgyzstan has 8,000+ glaciers and 2,000+ glacial lakes; GLOF events are existential risk for downstream Ferghana Valley population (UZ side) and KG hydropower infrastructure. KG-UP-2025-001 (state services improvement) and Digital Code (KG-LAW-2025-178) provide regulatory frame. Forthcoming KG-TF-2026-008 ($2.8M, AI disaster prevention — early warning) is in pipeline. case-kg-glof-warning documents the existing partial system. Netherlands Deltares Flood AI (case-nl-deltares-flood-ai) is the world reference. Geopolitical leverage: KG controls headwaters for Syr Darya basin which feeds UZ cotton industry — making KG glacier monitoring a regional security asset that ICWC (Interstate Commission for Water Coordination) and Central Asian states value.
initiatives.solution_concept: Three-layer system: (1) satellite + IoT sensor data fusion — Sentinel-2/Landsat satellite imagery + ground IoT sensors at high-risk glacial lakes, processed through computer-vision models for ice volume, lake area, and structural integrity; (2) GLOF risk prediction model — physics-informed ML (Deltares-style) producing 72-hour and 7-day risk forecasts per lake; (3) early warning operator console for KG Ministry of Emergency Situations, regional ICWC counterparts, and downstream hydropower operators (Toktogul, Naryn) in Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual. Architectural anchor: Deltares physics-informed flood AI (case-nl-deltares-flood-ai) preserved as core; adapted for KG glacial-lake context, Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual UX, ICWC regional sharing, and integration with KG-MINENERGY hydropower telemetry.
initiatives.what_preserved: Deltares physics-informed flood AI: data fusion, physics-informed ML, operator console — proven in Netherlands water management.
initiatives.what_adapted: Glacial-lake (not riverine flood) physics, KG mountain remote-sensing constraints, Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual UX, ICWC regional water-sharing protocol integration.
initiatives.regulatory_hurdles: Cross-border data sharing with UZ/TJ requires diplomatic framing under ICWC. Mitigation: structure as KG sovereign system with regional sharing API governed by ICWC protocol; align with EU C4CA regional connectivity framework.
initiatives.primary_funding: EU-KG-TEAM-EUROPE-DIGITAL + EFSD-KG-STABILIZATION + state Ministry of Emergency budget
initiatives.competitive_landscape: Deltares (Netherlands) is the global reference but expensive and slow to localize. ICIMOD (regional environmental NGO, Nepal-based) has glacier expertise but limited deployment muscle. ESA satellite providers have data but not full stack. Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual + AI inference fabric on Tunduk + ICWC-aware design is the differentiator. Open positioning.
initiatives.mandatory_local_partner: Central Asian Institute for Applied Geosciences (CAIAG) + Ministry of Emergency Situations technical team.
initiatives.win_conditions: (1) EU C4CA endorsement letter for regional integration framing; (2) Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual operator demo; (3) ICWC liaison letter for regional sharing protocol; (4) Deltares technical reference letter; (5) Toktogul/Naryn hydropower operator endorsement.
initiatives.pilot_scope: Pilot covering top 50 high-risk glacial lakes in Issyk-Kul, Naryn, and Chui oblasts with Sentinel-2 satellite analysis + 20 ground IoT sensors.
pilot_success_metrics: Top 50 high-risk lakes monitored with weekly satellite + daily IoT updates
≥85% precision on GLOF 7-day risk forecasts validated against historical events
Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual operator console deployed with named MoES users
Cross-border data sharing API live with ICWC integration test
Hydropower operator integration at Toktogul demonstrating early-warning escalation
initiatives.scale_up_path: Year 1: 50-lake pilot. Year 2: full 2,000+ glacial lakes coverage with Sentinel-2 + targeted IoT at top-200 risk lakes. Year 3: regional license to Tajikistan, regional ICWC integration, position as regional climate-security reference architecture.
initiatives.pitch_hook: Kyrgyzstan has 2,000+ glacial lakes and a 90%+ mountainous geography. KG-TF-2026-008 ($2.8M) procures the early-warning system. Deltares Flood AI proves physics-informed ML works at scale. We bring Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual sntz.ai stack and ICWC-aware regional sharing — KG glacier monitoring as climate-security asset for the entire Aral basin.

risk_register.description: Cross-border data sharing with UZ/TJ is politically sensitive — water rights are contested.
risk_register.mitigation: Structure system as KG-sovereign with explicit ICWC protocol governing what is shared and when; align with EU C4CA regional connectivity framework which provides diplomatic cover.

risk_register.description: Glacial-lake physics modeling is research-grade; translating Deltares riverine flood approach to glacial-lake outburst is non-trivial.
risk_register.mitigation: Partner with CAIAG (regional glaciology expertise) for physics validation; couple with Deltares technical reference letter and academic co-publication for credibility.

risk_register.description: EU C4CA may prefer to fund a Western European prime contractor (Deltares itself or French/German firm).
risk_register.mitigation: Position as cost-efficient regional implementer that complements Deltares technical reference; lead with Russian-Kyrgyz bilingual + on-the-ground Bishkek delivery capacity.

next_30_day_actions: LinkedIn message to kg-udp-digital-head (Adilbek Asanbekov) on climate-security framing of glacier AI.
Schedule meeting with EU-BOTH-C4CA PIU for regional integration endorsement letter.
Reach out to CAIAG (Central Asian Institute for Applied Geosciences) for glaciology partnership.

initiatives.one_liner: Build and deliver KG sovereign Kyrgyz-Russian bilingual LLM as foundation for government AI applications, hosted on UDP-supervised compute and aligned with the National AI Strategy under preparation.

Kyrgyz language is severely under-resourced in major foundation models (Llama, GPT, Claude) — government applications need a bilingual Kyrgyz-Russian model that Western and Russian commercial models cannot competently deliver.
initiatives.solution_concept: Three-component delivery: (1) bilingual Kyrgyz-Russian foundation model — base LLM trained on Kyrgyz language corpus (parliamentary, judicial, news, web data) plus Russian (CIS public data) plus continued pretraining from open-weight base (Mistral or Qwen) — published with open Kyrgyz-Russian benchmark; (2) government instruction-tuned variant — fine-tuned for KG government use cases (citizen-facing chatbot, document drafting, summarization, translation), deployed on Tunduk inference fabric (linked KG-INI-003); (3) developer toolkit — APIs, embeddings, fine-tuning recipes for downstream initiatives (CBDC chatbot, EHR clinician assistant, parliamentary analytics, Tunduk operator). Architectural anchor: UAE Falcon sovereign-fund-anchored model + France Albert government-LLM-as-service deployment pattern. Adapted for KG bilingual Kyrgyz-Russian (more under-resourced than Arabic), AUCA + HTP academic talent base, UDP-supervised compute.

solopreneur_mvps.tagline: Telegram bot that explains 1000+ EPIGU services in plain Uzbek and Russian; routes users to the right form on epigu.uz

underlying_demand.pain_point: EPIGU.uz hosts 1000+ services but the menu structure is opaque. Citizens spend 30-60 minutes hunting for the right service or call the agency directly. Mahalla-level rollout (PP-286) is forcing rural users into the portal who have never used it. Local Telegram groups (e.g. spot.uz news threads) routinely get 10-30 questions a day on which form to use for marriage certificates, driver-license renewal, child allowance applications. The state chatbot pilot is delayed.

solopreneur_mvps.target_customer: Tashkent and Andijan working-class adults 25-50 navigating EPIGU for the first time, especially women applying for child allowance and rural users now mandated by mahalla decree to use the portal

build_steps: Crawl epigu.uz public service catalog and tag each service with 5-10 Uzbek/Russian intent phrases
Build Telegram bot in n8n + Supabase using OpenAI GPT-4o-mini as the routing brain
Seed 50 most-asked services with hand-written walkthroughs in Russian and Uzbek (Latin)
Add 'submit a question' button — log unanswered queries to Airtable for daily improvement
Cross-post bot link in 5 Tashkent and 3 Fergana Telegram parent/community groups
Add Click/Payme micro-tip jar (50,000 UZS = $4 voluntary tip)

validation.signal_target: 1,500 unique bot users in 30 days, 20% repeat usage week 2
channels: Mahalla WhatsApp groups via researcher contacts

solopreneur_mvps.moat_potential: Continuous Q&A logging produces a proprietary Uzbek-language service-intent dataset; first 100K logs can be sold to UZINFOCOM as fine-tune data when official EPIGU chatbot procurement publishes (window: 2026-2027 per UP-189).

risk_register.risk: Government launches official chatbot and outcompetes free alternative
risk_register.mitigation: Position as 'unofficial concierge' that aggregates EPIGU + 5 sector portals (justice, tax, customs); maintain Telegram-native UX state app cannot match

risk_register.risk: EPIGU URL structure changes break crawler
risk_register.mitigation: Build crawler with sitemap-detection fallback; weekly diff alerts

risk_register.risk: OpenAI API blocked or expensive at scale
risk_register.mitigation: Migrate routing to local Yandex GPT or Llama-3 8B on Vast.ai; cache common queries at 80%+ rate

scoring.scoring_rationale: Demand verified by mahalla decree + EPIGU traffic; 7-day build; freemium tipping limited but data-moat to enterprise sale is real.
